focus: Angle 15 — stale references in catalogs and READMEs
filesReviewed: 1,100 catalog, README and playbook documents path-scanned; ~90 read in context

findingDetails.title: All three hubs' compiled-routing catalog entries cite a superseded runtime-layout generation in nine places
findingDetails.evidence: Each hub's entry names .opencode/bin/lib/compiled-routing/011-runtime-engine/lib/resolve.cjs at :28 and :52 and .opencode/bin/lib/compiled-routing/010-live-activation/activation/<hub>/manifest.json at :28 and :53; the layout root holds 013-live-activation and 014-runtime-engine, and the live front-door dependency is 014-runtime-engine/lib/resolve.cjs (confirmed on disk). Wave-one F014 expansion from one hub to three.
findingDetails.impact: Every reader of any hub's compiled-routing inventory gets a resolution-order description written against paths no consumer uses; three hubs now disagree with the runtime they document.
findingDetails.recommendation: Repoint the nine citations to 013-live-activation and 014-runtime-engine in all three entries. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Nine catalog references across four verified classes still cite files absent at the cited path
findingDetails.evidence: Class A archived spec path mk-deep-loop-guard.md:77 (.opencode/specs/deep-loops absent; live copies under specs/system-deep-loop/z_archive/025-...); class B graph-convergence.md:43 handler (no coverage-graph child of runtime/handlers); class C numbered playbook filenames stuck-detection.md:48 and resource-map-emission.md:50 (kebab files present); class D runtime/scripts/tests/ segment at two resource-map-emission.md:49 sites (test lives at runtime/tests/); ninth site mk-deep-loop-guard.md:86. Wave-one F015 re-verified.
findingDetails.impact: A reader following any of the nine pointers finds nothing; the catalogs' contract is that entries name live files.
findingDetails.recommendation: Repoint the nine references to their live paths or mark them historical. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Compiled-contracts README says four flattened contracts where three exist and the legacy README repeats the four-claim twice
findingDetails.evidence: compiled/README.md:19 'four flattened command contracts' versus three .contract.md files on disk and its own :23 'three commands'; legacy/README.md:13 and :87 repeat four against its own :19 'three fallback command bodies'.
findingDetails.impact: Developers reading the compiled-contracts reference cannot trust its inventory numbers; the same wrong number appears three times across the pair.
findingDetails.recommendation: Correct the three sentences to three. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Deep-review playbook still asserts no automated test suite exists while eighteen deep-review test files do
findingDetails.evidence: ':610' reads 'No dedicated automated test suite currently exists for deep-review'; re-located this iteration: eleven runtime/tests files (deep-review-*, review-depth-*), one system-spec-kit runtime/tests/deep-loop file, six system-spec-kit runtime/cli/tests files, plus the packet's own reduce-state-summary-fallback.test.cjs. Wave-one F019 re-verified.
findingDetails.impact: A false absence terminates the search; the section attaches no cross-reference and the sibling playbooks show the intended form.
findingDetails.recommendation: Replace the assertion with a test cross-reference in the sibling form. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Current-state docs across all three hubs still advertise skill-benchmark artifacts removed by the deprecation packet
findingDetails.evidence: Removed artifacts still cited: the sk-code router's drift guard at deep-improvement/scripts/skill-benchmark/tests/sk-code-router-sync.vitest.ts (:311) and its run command; the same guard as 'the equality authority' in alignment-verification-automation.md:112; 'consumed by the skill-benchmark router-replay' in five packet SKILL.md files; loop-host.cjs --mode=skill-benchmark commands in four benchmark READMEs against VALID_MODES {agent-improvement, model-benchmark} (unknown modes fall back); run-skill-benchmark.cjs in two scenario docs (file absent); /deep:skill-benchmark links in two benchmark READMEs; Lane C harness and scoring-contract links in two more.
findingDetails.impact: An enforcement guarantee names a deleted test, four runnable commands no longer run the lane they name, and five SKILL.md files claim a removed consumer; the deprecation packet asserts no dangling link remains.
findingDetails.recommendation: Run a completion pass over the 047 removal list: repoint or remove every citation, and decide whether the sk-code RESOURCE_MAP block needs a replacement enforcement guard. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Deep-ai-council playbook section 16 names five test files that exist only under their renamed multi- prefix
findingDetails.evidence: Rows at :403, :405, :406, :407 and :408 cite ai-council-{runtime-parity,permission-scope,audit-trail,rollback}.vitest.ts and cli/tests/ai-council-persist-artifacts.vitest.ts; the live files all carry the multi- prefix; no unprefixed file exists under system-spec-kit. The three remaining rows resolve.
findingDetails.impact: An operator running the cross-reference as written gets vitest's no-files-found error; the prefix drift matches the packet's own rename scenario.
findingDetails.recommendation: Update the five paths to their multi- prefixed names. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Runtime catalog still advertises fifty-five entries where headings, links and disk all give fifty-four
findingDetails.evidence: ':19' claims 'The 55 entries below'; this iteration counted 54 '###' headings, 54 index links and 54 entry documents on disk; wave one's category table also sums to 54. Wave-one F016 re-verified.
findingDetails.impact: A headline count a reader cannot check is wrong by one; every countable surface agrees with each other.
findingDetails.recommendation: Change the sentence to 54 or derive it. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Legacy README presents a repository-wide checker as a local acceptance test and the checker currently fails
findingDetails.evidence: ':102-108' instructs validate-command-references.cjs with 'expected result: the checker reports that command references resolve cleanly'; executed this iteration it prints 'FAIL 10 unresolved command reference(s)' and exits 1, all ten inside .opencode/commands/design/**. The checker scans repository-wide targets by default. Wave-one F020 re-verified.
findingDetails.impact: The validation block claims a guaranteed pass that does not hold, and its scope is wider than the document citing it.
findingDetails.recommendation: Scope the command to the legacy assets or state the known-failing surface. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Deep-research catalog and playbook cite a command path that no longer exists and a section anchor the successor lacks
findingDetails.evidence: progressive-synthesis.md:43 and jsonl-reconstruction-from-iteration-files.md:49,75 cite .opencode/commands/speckit/deep-research.md (absent); the speckit README's own tree places the command at deep/research.md; ':75' adds 'use ## 10. ERROR HANDLING' and the live command carries six sections with no such anchor.
findingDetails.impact: A reader following the citation finds no file, and repointing alone still leaves the section anchor unsatisfied.
findingDetails.recommendation: Repoint to .opencode/commands/deep/research.md and fix or drop the section anchor. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Two sk-code packet READMEs reference the parent hub and shared doctrine one directory level too high
findingDetails.evidence: sk-code-obsidian:96,118,161 and sk-code-mobile-cli:88,108,147 use ../../ROUTER.md, ../../mode-registry.json, ../../hub-router.json and ../../shared/; from a packet-root README those resolve to .opencode/skills/, which holds no router, registry or shared dir. Sibling packets use the correct depth (sk-code-quality/README.md:131; sk-code/shared/README.md:32).
findingDetails.impact: Six references in two packets promise navigation targets that do not exist, while four sibling packets show the correct form.
findingDetails.recommendation: Drop one ../ in all six references. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Deep-ai-council catalog cites rollback.js where the library is rollback.cjs
findingDetails.evidence: ':31' and ':43' cite scripts/lib/rollback.js (keyword block ':6' repeats the name); the directory holds README.md, audit-trail.cjs, findings-registry.cjs, persist-artifacts.cjs and rollback.cjs, and no .js file.
findingDetails.impact: The scenario's source pointer leads to nothing; the sibling libraries are all .cjs, so the extension is a single-file slip.
findingDetails.recommendation: Correct the two citations to rollback.cjs. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

findingDetails.title: Three agent-discipline stress scenarios and their setup script depend on a fixture root that does not exist
findingDetails.evidence: active-critic-overfit.md:109, proposal-only-boundary.md:114 and skill-load-not-protocol.md:111 list deep-improvement/test-fixtures/060-stress-test/ as fixture source; setup-cp-sandbox.sh:7 hardcodes it as FIXTURE_ROOT and guards it with require_path at :90-91. No test-fixtures/ directory exists under deep-improvement, and the deprecation packet does not mention the corpus.
findingDetails.impact: The sandbox setup fails closed with 'required path not found' and the three scenarios cannot be run as written; the removal path is unattributed.
findingDetails.recommendation: Restore the fixture corpus or repoint the scenarios and script. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: In-scope under angle 15 (catalog, README and playbook references under the three hubs).

searchLedger.hypothesis: The three hubs' compiled-routing entries cite a superseded layout generation.

searchActions.queryOrPath: the three entry docs lines 28, 52, 53 + the layout root listing
searchActions.result: Nine citations to 011-runtime-engine / 010-live-activation against a root holding 013-live-activation and 014-runtime-engine; live resolve.cjs and activation manifests confirmed.

searchLedger.rationale: Wave-one F014 confirmed and expanded from one hub to three; nine reproducible citations.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The four wave-one F015 stale-reference classes survive against the live tree.

searchActions.queryOrPath: each of the nine cited paths and its candidate live replacement
searchActions.result: Class A archived spec path absent (live copies under z_archive/025 confirmed); class B no coverage-graph handler dir; class C numbered playbook names absent, kebab files present; class D test at runtime/tests confirmed; ninth site fileless.

searchLedger.rationale: Wave-one F015 re-verified with this lane's own line evidence; nine references.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The two wave-one count claims still diverge from their directories.

searchActions.queryOrPath: runtime catalog headings/links/disk; compiled and legacy README count sentences
searchActions.result: 54/54/54 against a 55 claim; three contract files against a four claim repeated three times.

searchLedger.rationale: Wave-one F016 and F018 re-verified; filed separately to preserve their severities.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The deep-review playbook still asserts no test suite exists.

searchActions.queryOrPath: ':610' plus re-location of the eighteen-file population and the sibling playbooks' cross-reference form
searchActions.result: Assertion live; 17 named files found plus the packet regression; siblings carry cross-references.

searchLedger.rationale: Wave-one F019 re-verified; the false absence is the defect, not the omission.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The legacy README's validation block claims a clean checker pass and the checker fails.

searchActions.result: FAIL 10 unresolved command reference(s), exit 1, all ten in .opencode/commands/design/**; default targets are repository-wide.

searchLedger.rationale: Wave-one F020 re-verified on both arms by execution.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Docs across the three hubs still advertise artifacts removed by the skill-benchmark deprecation.

searchActions.queryOrPath: rg skill-benchmark / router-replay / run-skill-benchmark across the three hubs excluding reports and changelogs
searchActions.result: Enforcement, consumer, command and link arms enumerated; every claimed removed path checked absent; loop-host VALID_MODES read to confirm fallback behavior.

searchLedger.rationale: New ground for this lane; the enforcement arm in sk-code/ROUTER.md is the strongest site.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The council test cross-reference names files that were renamed with the mode.

searchActions.queryOrPath: search system-spec-kit for the eight cited test names and their multi- variants
searchActions.result: Five cited names absent; multi- prefixed files present; three other rows resolve.

searchLedger.rationale: Rename-prefix drift; the table was not updated when the tests moved.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Deep-research docs cite a speckit command path that no longer exists.

searchActions.queryOrPath: speckit README tree, deep/research.md sections, cited files' contexts
searchActions.result: speckit/deep-research.md absent; live command under deep/; no section 10 ERROR HANDLING in the successor.

searchLedger.rationale: Three citations, two files, one live successor that only partially satisfies the reference.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Two packet READMEs use a two-level relative prefix where one level is correct.

searchActions.queryOrPath: the six citation lines plus sibling packets' equivalent references
searchActions.result: ../../ resolves to .opencode/skills/ which holds no router/registry/shared; sibling form uses ../.

searchLedger.rationale: Six references in two of six packets; a copy-lineage slip, not a convention.

searchLedger.hypothesis: One council catalog cites a library as .js where the file is .cjs.

searchActions.queryOrPath: ls of the council scripts/lib directory against the cited path
searchActions.result: No .js file; rollback.cjs present with its three siblings.

searchLedger.rationale: Single-file extension slip on two lines plus the keyword block.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The stress scenarios' fixture root does not exist and the setup script guards it.

searchActions.queryOrPath: dir search for test-fixtures and 060-stress-test; read of the setup script's require_path calls; check of the 047 removal list
searchActions.result: Fixture root absent; script fails closed at :90-91; deprecation packet does not mention the corpus.

searchLedger.rationale: Dead dependency; removal attribution left open rather than guessed.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A mode catalog index may omit or mislink an entry document.

searchActions.queryOrPath: per-link resolution of every index href against disk for the four mode catalogs
searchActions.result: All links resolve and category counts match (25/25, 33/33, 29/29/29, 19/19); an initial first-pass flag was a normalization artifact and was refuted.

searchLedger.rationale: Four mode-catalog indexes are structurally consistent; recorded so the negative result is not rediscovered.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A fixture path in a scenario document may be a stale claim.

searchActions.result: The path is conditioned on future work ('once T048 lands') and a hand-constructed alternative is offered; not a claim that the fixture exists.

searchLedger.rationale: Forward references are not stale references; excluded from the census.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Raw path extraction may treat scenario prompt markers and env-var templates as file references.

searchActions.result: These are prompt inputs and template variables, not reachability claims; excluded.

searchLedger.rationale: The census required context reading; the raw candidate set is not evidence.

selectedTargets: every catalog index and entry document under the three hubs and their five mode trees
every README under the three hubs excluding node_modules and benchmark report archives
every manual-testing-playbook document and scenario under the three hubs
targetSelection.selectionReason: Angle 15 names catalogs, READMEs and playbooks and the sweep must find cited paths, counts and claims the tree contradicts; the deprecation packet was added because the compiled path scan kept returning removed-lane artifacts.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: A three-hub sweep over 1,100 documents with four counted catalog trees, two executed checkers and a removal-list census against the deprecation packet.
